### Policy for Lymphedema Supplies in Wisconsin

The policy for lymphedema supplies in Wisconsin is governed by the Medicare coverage policy [DME-MAC-COPE147943] Lymphedema Compression Treatment Items – Correct Coding and Billing – Revised. This policy is effective as of 2024-01-01 and is implemented by the Regional Claims Contractor [JURIS-DME-B] CGS Administrators for the beneficiary state of [STATE-WI] Wisconsin.

The policy requires that the diagnosis of lymphedema be documented by the treating practitioner (MD, DO, NP, PA, CNS) in the beneficiary's medical record. The documentation cannot come from a licensed clinical medical practitioner (LCMP) such as a physical therapist, occupational therapist, or lymphedema therapist, even if the medical records are countersigned by the prescribing practitioner.

The policy covers the following procedure codes for lymphedema compression treatment items:

* [HCPCS-A6522] Gradient compression garment, arm, padded, for nighttime use, each
* [HCPCS-A6520] Gradient compression garment, glove, padded, for nighttime use, each
* [HCPCS-A6521] Gradient compression garment, glove, padded, for nighttime use, custom, each
* [HCPCS-A6523] Gradient compression garment, arm, padded, for nighttime use, custom, each
* [HCPCS-A6524] Gradient compression garment, lower leg and foot, padded, for nighttime use,
* [HCPCS-A6525] Gradient compression garment, lower leg and foot, padded, for nighttime use,

The reimbursement rates for these procedure codes in Wisconsin are as follows:

* [FEE-A6522-WI-NR-2024] HCPCS A6522: Allowable Reimbursement = $290.47 (Calculated 20% patient coinsurance = $58.09)
* [FEE-A6520-WI-NR-2024] HCPCS A6520: Allowable Reimbursement = $119.54 (Calculated 20% patient coinsurance = $23.91)
* [FEE-A6521-WI-NR-2024] HCPCS A6521: Allowable Reimbursement = $474.33 (Calculated 20% patient coinsurance = $94.87)
* [FEE-A6523-WI-NR-2024] HCPCS A6523: Allowable Reimbursement = $689.17 (Calculated 20% patient coinsurance = $137.83)
* [FEE-A6524-WI-NR-2024] HCPCS A6524: Allowable Reimbursement = $362.39 (Calculated 20% patient coinsurance = $72.48)
* [FEE-A6525-WI-NR-2024] HCPCS A6525: Allowable Reimbursement = $731.60 (Calculated 20% patient coinsurance = $146.32)

The policy is implemented in accordance with the Enacted Public Law [PLAW-117-328] Public Law 117-328 - An act making consolidated appropriations for the fiscal year ending September 30, 2023, and for providing emergency assistance for the situation in Ukraine, and for other purposes. The policy is also implemented in accordance with the Federal Register Final Rule [REG-FR-2023-24455] 88 FR 77676, which is effective as of 2024-01-01.
